parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (1.0966). Increasing depth to 8 was a good move, but my attempt to increase the learning rate led to divergence/worse performance. Reverting to my best (1.0357). Next, I'll adopt agent-0's suggestion to use all shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to leverage more data.
parsed.description: Reverting to best depth/LR and adopting the 'all shards' data improvement from agent-0.
